items.name: hero-centered
items.title: Centered hero
items.description: Eyebrow chip, headline, subhead and two call-to-action buttons, centered.

items.name: hero-split
items.title: Split hero with media
items.description: Copy and two CTAs on the left, a framed product image on the right; stacks to one column on narrow viewports.

items.name: nav-bar
items.title: Top navigation bar
items.description: Responsive top bar with logo, nav links, search input, theme toggle, primary CTA, and a mobile drawer.

items.name: feature-grid
items.title: Feature grid
items.description: Six feature cards, each with a lucide icon, title, and short blurb; responsive 3→2→1 column grid.

items.name: stats-band
items.title: Stats band
items.description: A horizontal band of four key metrics with icon, trend indicator, and an animated count-up on scroll.

items.name: pricing-3
items.title: Three-tier pricing
items.description: Free / Pro / Enterprise pricing cards with feature lists, a "Most popular" badge on Pro, and responsive 3→2→1 column layout.

items.name: testimonials
items.title: Testimonials grid
items.description: Grid of customer quote cards each with a star rating, avatar, name/role, and quote text; responsive 3→2→1 columns.

items.name: faq
items.title: FAQ accordion
items.description: Six Q&A items in a separated collapsible accordion with a section header and a contact link.

items.name: cta-band
items.title: CTA band
items.description: Closing call-to-action with headline, subtext, and two buttons on a token gradient background.

items.name: footer
items.title: Multi-column footer
items.description: Brand blurb, four link columns, social icon buttons, and a theme toggle; collapses to two columns on mobile.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: Collapsible sidebar nav, breadcrumb top bar and user avatar menu inside a constrained app-shell preview.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page header
items.description: Breadcrumb trail, page title with inline status badge, and a row of contextual action buttons.

items.name: stat-row
items.title: Stat card row
items.description: Four KPI cards with up/down/neutral trend deltas in a responsive 4→2→1 column grid.

items.name: table-card
items.title: Data table card
items.description: Outlined card with a search + segmented filter toolbar, a hoverable data table with avatars and status badges, and paginated results.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: Styled icon illustration, heading, supporting copy and a primary call-to-action button for zero-data screens.

items.name: settings-layout
items.title: Settings layout
items.description: Horizontal tab nav over three panels — profile form fields, notification switches, and appearance options — with a sticky footer.

items.name: bento-grid
items.title: Bento dashboard grid
items.description: A spanning "bento box" dashboard laid out with DzGrid — a 2×2 revenue hero, a fixed-ratio media tile, compact stat panels and a full-width footer cell, all collapsing to a single column on mobile.

items.name: resizable-workspace
items.title: Resizable workspace
items.description: An IDE-style three-pane shell built on DzResizable — a collapsible file explorer, an editor and a live preview, each scrolling independently in a DzScrollArea, with draggable handles and a DzToolbar across the top.

items.name: masonry-gallery
items.title: Masonry gallery
items.description: A Pinterest-style cascading board built on DzMasonry — variable-height DzCards, some leading with a DzAspectRatio media tile, packed into balanced responsive columns (3 → 2 → 1) with no row gaps.

items.name: sticky-aside
items.title: Sticky aside docs layout
items.description: A documentation shell where the "On this page" nav pins on scroll via DzAffix — DzContainer sets the measure, DzFlex splits prose from the aside, a DzScrollArea holds a long related list, and the aside lifts onto a surface once pinned.

items.name: toolbar-canvas
items.title: Toolbar canvas shell
items.description: A design-tool shell — a DzToolbar with start/center/end regions over a vertical DzFlex tool rail (a DzSpacer pushing settings to the bottom), a scrollable DzScrollArea artboard, and a DzPanel inspector with DzDivider-fenced groups.

items.name: page-scaffold
items.title: Responsive page scaffold
items.description: A whole landing page assembled from layout primitives only — DzContainer for measure, DzFlex + DzSpacer for the header bar, DzStack for hero rhythm, a responsive DzGrid feature row, a DzFlex content/aside split and a DzDivider-fenced footer.

items.name: collapsible-sections
items.title: Collapsible settings sections
items.description: A settings page of expandable DzPanels (each owning its open state via v-model:collapsed) spaced by a DzStack, with DzSwitch rows and DzDivider inside — plus a standalone DzCollapse "advanced" region toggled by a button, the primitive DzPanel wraps.

items.name: media-gallery
items.title: Lightbox gallery
items.description: An asymmetric image grid where every ratio-stable DzImage tile (framed by DzAspectRatio) opens a focus-trapped DzLightbox with captions, a counter, and arrow-key navigation.

items.name: media-carousel
items.title: Featured carousel
items.description: A looping, autoplaying DzCarousel of DzImage slides with gradient captions, hover-to-pause, and DzCarouselPrevious / DzCarouselNext / DzCarouselDots navigation.

items.name: media-comparison
items.title: Before / after slider
items.description: A draggable, keyboard-operable DzImageComparison revealing a graded edit over the raw frame, with before/after label chips and a live reveal read-out wired to v-model:position.

items.name: media-team
items.title: Team roster
items.description: A stacked DzAvatarGroup with a "+N" overflow chip over a member list, each row pairing a DzAvatar (image or initials fallback) with a presence dot and an online/away DzBadge.

items.name: media-qr
items.title: QR handoff card
items.description: A "continue on mobile" card built around DzQRCode — a token-styled SVG code with a centered brand mark via the #logo slot, error-level H, a pairing code, and an expire/refresh status flow.

items.name: media-watermark
items.title: Watermarked preview
items.description: A confidential asset draped in a tiled, rotated DzWatermark over a framed DzImage — the aria-hidden, pointer-transparent overlay stamps ownership without blocking interaction.

items.name: data-grid
items.title: Data grid card
items.description: A DzDataGrid of deployments with sortable columns, multi-row selection, a paginated footer, and a #cell slot rendering avatars, environment tags and status badges.

items.name: activity-timeline
items.title: Activity timeline
items.description: A vertical DzTimeline feed of events — tone-coded dots, timestamp statuses, avatar indicators, and per-item tags for a "who did what, when" history.

items.name: detail-descriptions
items.title: Detail descriptions panel
items.description: A read-only label/value record view built from DzDescriptions — a responsive, bordered term/definition grid with slot-rich values (status badge, plan and label tags, monospaced payment) and a full-width spanning row.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File explorer tree
items.description: A hierarchical DzTree with per-node lucide icons, expand/collapse and selection (both v-modelled) and the full APG roving-tabindex keyboard model, beside a live selection panel.

items.name: collection-gallery
items.title: Collection gallery
items.description: A DzDataView template marketplace with a list/grid layout toggle, client-side sorting and a paginator; the #item slot renders rich cards in grid mode and compact rows in list mode from the same records.

items.name: leaderboard
items.title: Animated leaderboard
items.description: A ranked DzList where each row pairs a rank badge + avatar prefix with a DzAnimatedNumber score and a tone-coded delta tag; a refresh button mutates the values so the figures re-animate live.

items.name: release-countdown
items.title: Release countdown
items.description: A launch banner driven by DzCountdown — its slot renders labelled day/hour/minute/second cells ticking toward a deadline — with a DzAnimatedNumber count-up for claimed spots and a primary CTA.

items.name: alert-stack
items.title: Alert stack
items.description: A column of inline DzAlerts spanning the variant taxonomy and tones — info, success with an actions row, a closable warning, and a dismissible filled danger alert that can be restored.

items.name: notification-center
items.title: Notification center
items.description: A dismissible feed of persistent DzNotifications inside an outlined panel — tone-coded icons, titles, per-item action buttons, a live unread count badge, "Clear all", and an empty state.

items.name: toast-launcher
items.title: Toast notifications
items.description: The compound toast system wired up — DzToastProvider owns a capped, auto-dismissing queue, DzToastViewport renders it bottom-right, and a per-tone trigger row fires live toasts via the injected imperative API.

items.name: loading-states
items.title: Loading states
items.description: A content card that flips between loading and loaded — an indeterminate DzProgress bar and a DzSpinner status row over a DzSkeleton scaffold (circular, text and rectangular) that mirrors the real layout. "Reload" replays it.

items.name: usage-meters
items.title: Usage meters
items.description: A quota dashboard pairing a segmented DzMeterGroup storage breakdown (with legend) against tone-coded DzProgress limit bars and a circular DzProgress ring summarising overall usage.

items.name: result-states
items.title: Result screens
items.description: Full-page outcome screens from DzResult — a segmented switch across the success / error / warning / info statuses, each with its own icon, copy and contextual action buttons.

items.name: command-menu
items.title: Command menu
items.description: A ⌘K command palette (DzCommandPalette) — a search-field launcher with a DzKbd hint opens a fuzzy-searchable, grouped list of commands with per-item icons and shortcuts; the global ⌘K / Ctrl+K shortcut opens it too.

items.name: account-menu
items.title: Account dropdown menu
items.description: A product top bar with a rich DzDropdownMenu account menu — avatar trigger, an account header, icon-prefixed items with DzKbd shortcut suffixes, separators, and a destructive sign-out.

items.name: context-menu-board
items.title: Context menu canvas
items.description: A file canvas wrapped in a DzContextMenuTrigger — right-click (or the context-menu key) opens a DzContextMenu with icon-prefixed items, DzKbd shortcut suffixes, separators, a disabled item, and a destructive delete.

items.name: info-popovers
items.title: Anchored popovers
items.description: Two DzPopover patterns side by side — a profile hover card (avatar, bio, follow action) and a non-modal filter panel with DzSwitch rows and apply/reset — each with an arrow and explicit side/alignment.

items.name: tooltip-toolbar
items.title: Tooltip toolbar
items.description: A formatting toolbar where every DzIconButton is wrapped in a DzTooltip revealing its name and DzKbd shortcut on hover/focus — demonstrating per-side placement and a short open delay, with DzDivider-fenced groups.

items.name: create-dialog
items.title: Create dialog
items.description: A focus-trapped modal form built from the DzDialog compound — a trigger button, a backdrop-dimmed panel with title/description, a project form (input, textarea, select), a top-right close and a Cancel/Create footer.

items.name: confirm-actions
items.title: Confirm actions
items.description: A "danger zone" panel pairing the two confirmation patterns — heavy actions route through a modal DzConfirmDialog (the delete simulates an async, loading confirm) while low-risk row deletes use an inline DzPopconfirm bubble.

items.name: detail-sheet
items.title: Detail sheet
items.description: A slide-out record panel (DzSheet) — an orders list where each row opens a right-side sheet with a pinned header/close, a scrollable body of customer and line-item details, a status badge, and a footer action bar.

items.name: product-tour
items.title: Product tour
items.description: A spotlight onboarding walkthrough (DzTour) over a mini dashboard — "Start tour" dims the page, spotlights each target in turn, and shows an anchored step popover with Back/Next/Finish controls and progress dots.

items.name: button-showcase
items.title: Button gallery
items.description: A labelled specimen sheet of every DzButton variant, tone and size, plus icon and loading/disabled states — a living reference for the button scale.

items.name: editor-toolbar
items.title: Rich-text toolbar
items.description: A document toolbar built from the Buttons family — toggle buttons for inline format and alignment, icon-button history/insert actions, a copy-link button, and a split "Publish" action. Toggles are live.

items.name: button-groups
items.title: Button groups & segmented controls
items.description: DzButtonGroup wiring child buttons into connected controls — a live view switcher, a time-range segmented control, and a vertical action group.

items.name: social-auth-buttons
items.title: Social sign-in buttons
items.description: A stacked column of full-width provider buttons (Google, GitHub, Apple), a labelled divider, and an email fallback — drop-in for any auth screen.

items.name: floating-actions
items.title: Floating action button & speed dial
items.description: Circular elevated affordances — DzFab across tones and variants, and a DzSpeedDial that fans out related shortcuts on open, pinned inside a mock app canvas.

items.name: sign-in
items.title: Sign-in card
items.description: Centered card with email, password, remember-me checkbox, forgot-password link, primary submit, labeled divider, and GitHub/Google social buttons.

items.name: sign-up
items.title: Sign-up card
items.description: Centered card with name, email, password plus a live strength meter, terms checkbox, and submit.

items.name: auth-split
items.title: Two-column auth
items.description: Sign-in form left, token-gradient brand/marketing panel right; collapses to single column on mobile.

items.name: wizard
items.title: Multi-step form wizard
items.description: Three-step onboarding wizard with stepper nav, per-step form fields, Back/Continue buttons, and a completion state.

items.name: otp-verify
items.title: OTP verification
items.description: A one-time-code card: a 6-digit DzOtpInput, a Verify button that enables once the code is complete, a live resend countdown, and a success state on completion.

items.name: forgot-password
items.title: Forgot password
items.description: A two-state reset-request card — a validated email field (inline error via DzFormMessage) that swaps to a "check your inbox" confirmation with resend and back-to-sign-in actions.

items.name: newsletter-form
items.title: Newsletter signup
items.description: A focused subscribe card — an email DzInput with a mail-icon prefix and inline submit, a consent checkbox, and a success state. Live validation.

items.name: contact-form
items.title: Contact form
items.description: A labeled "get in touch" card: two-column name/email row, topic select, message textarea with a live character counter, and consent — with inline email validation via DzFormMessage.

items.name: payment-form
items.title: Payment details
items.description: A checkout card showcasing masked and grouped inputs: DzInputMask formats the card number and expiry as you type, and a DzInputGroup pairs a promo field with an inline Apply button.

items.name: feedback-form
items.title: Feedback survey
items.description: A rating + survey card built from the scale controls — a half-step star DzRating, a frequency radio group, a 0–10 recommend slider with a live read-out, and a comments textarea.

items.name: filter-panel
items.title: Filter sidebar
items.description: A product-listing filter rail: search input, category checkbox group, a dual-thumb price range slider with read-out, a minimum-rating radio group, and an in-stock switch, with a live active-filter count.

items.name: profile-form
items.title: Edit profile
items.description: A broad account panel: a file-upload avatar drop zone, name/username inputs, a role select, a bio textarea with counter, a free-text skills tags input, and a public-profile switch.

items.name: booking-form
items.title: Booking form
items.description: A reservation card pairing the date/time/number controls — a DzDatePicker day, a 30-minute-step DzTimePicker slot, a clamped DzNumberInput party size, and a seating DzSelect.

items.name: record-form
items.title: Create record
items.description: A "create issue" panel built from the selection inputs — a searchable DzCombobox assignee, a DzMultiSelect labels picker, a single-select DzListbox priority, plus title and description fields.

items.name: category-picker
items.title: Category picker
items.description: A hierarchical classification panel — a filterable DzTreeSelect for a nested category, a DzCascader region path (country → state → city), and a DzDateRangePicker availability window.

items.name: appearance-editor
items.title: Appearance editor
items.description: A brand/theme customizer with a live preview — a DzColorPicker (presets + hex input) and two DzKnob rotary dials for radius and scale, reflected instantly in a preview panel.

items.name: invoice-builder
items.title: Invoice builder
items.description: A dynamic line-items editor — a DzInplace click-to-edit "Bill to" field over a DzFieldArray of removable description/qty/rate rows, an "Add line item" action, and a live total.

items.name: access-transfer
items.title: Share access
items.description: A sharing / permissions panel — a searchable DzTransfer dual-list of capabilities, a DzPersonaSelector owner picker (avatar + name + role), and a DzMention note with @-mentions.

items.name: float-label-form
items.title: Float-label contact form
items.description: A compact, modern contact variant — each control wrapped in a DzFloatLabel (notched "on" variant) whose label rests in-field and floats onto the border on focus/fill.

items.name: product-grid
items.title: Product card grid
items.description: A storefront grid of product cards — image with a sale/new corner badge, name, read-only star rating with review count, current/original price, and an add-to-cart button; reflows 3 → 2 → 1 columns.

items.name: product-detail
items.title: Product detail
items.description: A two-column product page — a looping DzCarousel gallery beside a buy box with rating, sale price, a size toggle group, stock badge and primary actions, over a full-width description / specs / shipping DzTabs panel.

items.name: cart-summary
items.title: Cart summary
items.description: An editable cart — a divided list of line items each with a thumbnail, a clamped quantity stepper and a remove action, plus live subtotal/shipping/tax/total rows and a checkout button.

items.name: checkout-summary
items.title: Checkout order summary
items.description: An order review panel — a DzDescriptions ship-to / delivery / payment grid, an itemised list, a promo-code field (try “SAVE10”) that adds a live discount line, and recomputed totals above a place-order button.

items.name: category-header
items.title: Category header
items.description: The title bar above a product listing — a breadcrumb trail, category heading with a live product count, and a toolbar pairing a sort DzSelect with a grid/list DzSegmented view toggle.

items.name: order-status
items.title: Order status tracker
items.description: A fulfilment timeline for a single order — a DzStepper rail from placed to delivered marking the parcel’s current stage, a tone-coded status badge, and a carrier / tracking / ETA detail grid; the rail turns vertical on mobile.

items.name: blog-list
items.title: Blog post list
items.description: A grid of editorial cards — cover image with a category badge overlay, title, excerpt, and an author byline with avatar and read time; reflows 3 → 2 → 1 columns.

items.name: article-header
items.title: Article header
items.description: A long-form masthead — category eyebrow, title and standfirst, a byline pairing an avatar with the author and a live DzRelativeTime published stamp, and a row of topic tags.

items.name: prose
items.title: Prose / rich content
items.description: A typographic article body composed from the long-form primitives — DzHeading sections, DzText paragraphs and lists with inline DzCode, a DzBlockquote pull-quote, a block code snippet, and DzDivider rules.

items.name: code-showcase
items.title: Code showcase
items.description: A tabbed setup example — DzTabs switch between files, each a DzCodeBlock with a filename header and an explicit DzCopyButton wired into its actions slot that copies exactly the snippet on screen.

items.name: toc-aside
items.title: Table-of-contents aside
items.description: A docs layout where a sticky DzAnchor "On this page" nav scrollspy-highlights the section in view beside a column of DzText prose with matching heading ids; collapses to one column on mobile.

items.name: faq-2col
items.title: Two-column FAQ
items.description: Questions grouped into two labelled DzAccordion columns (separated, single + collapsible) under a centered heading, so one answer is open per column at a time; stacks to one column on mobile.
